Chapter 6638: Seize It All

Chapter 6638: Seize It All

Even an immortal couldn’t stop the personal tribulation from initiating.

“Crackle!” Light God and Sixth-sense started pulsing brightly, especially the latter.

Thunderous flashes emanated from him, not the external tribulations. Their tribulation had begun and oozed out of the crack.

These tribulations were meant for immortals and most importantly, aimed at their weakness - their heart devil.

“The high heaven’s eye is opening, we must shroud it.” Light God shouted at Sixth-sense.

Those who heard this immediately turned pale and went into hiding. The high heaven’s power intensified, ready to deliver sentences. Those who couldn’t run enough became paralyzed, afraid like a mouse caught by a cat.

“Ahh!” Sixth-sense screamed as he grabbed the special bolt and forced it into his body.

He became the target of the tribulations immediately. They obliterated his flesh and left countless holes.

“Buzz.” A primordial light erupted and turned into laws wrapping around his body and keeping it together. They formed an armor, preventing total destruction. This particular light could eliminate Three Immortals if used offensively.

“He’s not Sixth-sense for sure.” It became obvious since no primal ancestors could survive this.

“Ahh!” Meanwhile, Light God erupted with a holy light.

“Get out!” His scream echoed across space.

Once the high heaven opened its eyes, Bao Pu became suppressed. His fear of the high heaven exceeded anyone else’s.

Therefore, this gave Light God an opportunity. His mind returned and he unleashed all of his light, wanting to expel Bao Pu. An immortal light surged out of his mind as well, taking the shape of a pair of wings to protect him.

Three immortal figures appeared, granting him their blessing.

“Bam!” Flesh and blood exploded from his body, shaking the hiding Bao Pu.

“The light and blessing? They originated from me?! I gave them to you and will seize them back now!” Bao Pu was furious.

In a sense, Bao Pu was Light God’s creator. Now, his subject dared to rebel?

“Bam!” Bao Pu, on the verge of splitting away, coiled around Light God, wanting to finish the takeover.

“Die!” Light God summoned the primordial law given to him by Li Qiye.

“No!” Bao Pu bellowed in horror but Light God inserted it into his heart without any hesitation, piercing it entirely.

“Ahh!” Bao Pu’s figure screamed in pain.

“Clank!” The law disintegrated everything regarding Light God including his true fate into strands resembling willow seeds.

“No!!!” Bao Pu’s ace cards including his secrets, mantras, and everything else also disintegrated.
